title: 第3章 觉醒猫男与系统下第4章 开局荒峰种猫草上
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
冰冷的草席硌着脊背，漏顶的破屋灌进湿冷的风，但这些感官刺激，此刻在林墨的意识里都变得模糊而遥远。
他的全部心神，都被那两处新生的、毛茸茸的“部件”
死死攥住，拽入了无底的惊悚深渊。
头顶……毛茸茸，软乎乎，还能动！
身后……灵活，不受控制，带着尾巴尖扫过皮肤的痒意！
“猫耳？猫尾？！”
这两个血淋淋的字眼如同烧红的烙铁，狠狠烫在他的灵魂深处。
荒谬！
惊悚！
天旋地转！
他宁愿自己还在蓝星那个令人窒息的格子间里熬夜猝死，也好过穿越过来就变成……变成个怪物！
“冷静！
林墨，冷静！”
他拼命在心底嘶吼，试图用两世为人的理智压垮这灭顶的恐慌。
但身体的本能却先一步背叛了他——那对该死的、不受控制的黑色猫耳，因为极度的恐惧和紧张，猛地向后紧贴住了头发，变成了两个紧贴在头顶的、警惕的小飞机耳！
身后的猫尾更是瞬间炸毛，蓬松得像个鸡毛掸子，僵硬地竖在身后，尾尖神经质地小幅度颤抖着。
这生理反应带来的触感反馈，如同最后一根稻草，彻底压垮了他摇摇欲坠的心理防线。
“不——！”
一声压抑到极致的、带着撕裂感的低吼从他喉咙里挤出。
他再也顾不得头痛欲裂，猛地从冰冷的草席上弹坐起来，双手如同闪电般抓向自己的头顶！

**触感！
**真实的、温暖的、覆盖着细腻短绒毛的软肉！
那结构分明是……耳廓！
顶端还带着一点微尖的弧度！
他甚至能清晰地感觉到指尖下薄薄的皮肤包裹着的软骨的轮廓！
恐惧如同冰冷的毒蛇，缠绕心脏，越收越紧。
他僵硬地、一寸寸地扭动脖颈，试图用眼角的余光去捕捉身后那根“异物”
的存在。
破屋昏暗，只有窗外偶尔划过的惨白闪电能提供瞬间的光亮。
就在一道电光撕裂夜幕的刹那！
**唰！
**
一条覆盖着油亮黑色短毛的、灵活而有力的尾巴，如同拥有独立生命的活物，清晰地映入了他的视野边缘！
它正因为他剧烈的起身动作而本能地摆动了一下，试图维持身体的平衡，尾尖扫过草席，发出细微的“沙沙”
声。
不是幻觉！
不是噩梦！
是真的！
林墨如遭雷击，整个人僵在原地，瞳孔因极致的惊骇而剧烈收缩。
冷汗瞬间浸透了单薄的里衣，黏腻冰冷地贴在皮肤上。

他像个被施了定身咒的木偶，双手还死死抓着头顶那对毛茸茸的耳朵，指尖用力到发白，仿佛想把这不该存在的东西硬生生揪下来。
content_en:
The cold straw mat hurt his back, and the cold and wet wind filled the broken house with a leaky roof, but these sensory stimulations became vague and distant in Lin Mo's consciousness at this moment.
His whole mind was occupied by those two new, furry "parts"
He held on tightly and was dragged into the bottomless abyss of horror.
The top of the head... is furry, soft, and can move!
Behind him... he was flexible and uncontrollable, with the itching sensation of the tip of his tail brushing against his skin!
"Cat ears? Cat tail?!"
These two bloody words were like a red-hot iron, burning into the depths of his soul.
absurd!
Horror!
The world is spinning!
He would rather stay up late and die suddenly in the suffocating cubicle of Blue Star than to travel through time and become... a monster!
"Calm down!
Lin Mo, calm down! "
He screamed desperately in his heart, trying to suppress the panic of annihilation with the rationality of a man in two lifetimes.
But his body's instinct betrayed him first - those damn, uncontrollable black cat ears, because of extreme fear and nervousness, suddenly moved back and clung to his hair, turning into two vigilant little airplane ears clinging to the top of his head!
The cat's tail behind him suddenly became fluffy and fluffy like a feather duster. It stood stiffly behind him and the tip of the tail trembled slightly nervously.
The tactile feedback brought about by this physiological reaction was like the last straw, completely crushing his shaky psychological defense.
"No-!"
An extremely suppressed, tearing growl was squeezed out of his throat.
He no longer cared about the splitting headache, and suddenly sat up from the cold straw mat, grabbing the top of his head with his hands like lightning!
**Touch!
**Real, warm, soft flesh covered with fine short hair!
That structure is clearly...the auricle!
The top also has a slight curvature!
He could even clearly feel the outline of the cartilage wrapped in thin skin under his fingertips!
Fear is like a cold snake, wrapping around the heart, tightening tighter and tighter.
He twisted his neck stiffly and inch by inch, trying to catch the "foreign object" behind him with the corner of his eye.
existence.
The dilapidated house was dark, with only the occasional flash of pale lightning outside the window providing momentary light.
At the moment when a bolt of lightning tore through the night!
**Shua!
**
A flexible and powerful tail covered with shiny black short hair, like a living creature with independent life, was clearly reflected in the edge of his field of vision!
It was swinging instinctively because of his violent rising movement, trying to maintain the balance of its body, and the tip of its tail swept across the straw mat, making a subtle "rustling"
sound.
Not an illusion!
Not a nightmare!
It's true!
Lin Moru was struck by lightning and froze in place, his pupils shrinking violently due to extreme horror.
Cold sweat instantly soaked through the thin inner clothes, sticking to the skin with a sticky and cold texture.
He was like a puppet that had been cast a restraining spell. He was still clutching the pair of furry ears on his head with both hands, and his fingertips were so hard that they turned white, as if he wanted to forcefully pull out this thing that shouldn't exist.
